# vyos.blueprints.wan_load_balance

WAN load balancing and failover (docs blueprint "WAN Load Balancer examples")

- Configures interface health checks (ping targets, failure count, next hop) and load-balancing rules - balance, weighted failover, rule-order failover, priority traffic per protocol/port, and exclusions.
- Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no load-balancing module.
- Rules are owned by the role. With `wan_load_balance_prune_rules` (the default), `load-balancing wan rule` settings that are not in `wan_load_balance_rules` are deleted, so moving between designs (for example from balancing to failover) leaves no stale rule settings. Health-check settings are only added.
- Static routes to the ping targets (and a default route) belong to `vyos.blueprints.base` (`base_static_routes`).

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.wan_load_balance
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces` | list | yes |  | WAN interfaces and their health checks. |
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | WAN interface, e.g. `eth0`. |
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces.nexthop` | str |  |  | Next hop (ISP gateway) for this interface. |
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces.failure_count` | int |  |  | Failed tests before the interface is removed from the pool. |
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces.success_count` | int |  |  | Successful tests before it is added back. |
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces.tests` | list |  | `[]` | Health tests. |
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces.tests.id` | int | yes |  | Test number. |
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces.tests.type` | str |  | `ping` | Test type, e.g. `ping`. |
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces.tests.target` | str | yes |  | Address to test. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules` | list | yes |  | Load-balancing rules, matched in number order. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.number` | int | yes |  | Rule number. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.description` | str |  |  | Rule description. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.inbound_interface` | str | yes |  | Interface the traffic enters on, e.g. `eth2` or `eth+`. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Outgoing WAN interfaces; omit for `exclude` rules. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | WAN interface. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.interfaces.weight` | int |  |  | Weight (higher is preferred in failover mode). |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.failover` | bool |  | `false` | Use only the highest-weight healthy interface. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.exclude` | bool |  | `false` | Exclude matching traffic from load balancing. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.protocol` | str |  |  | Protocol, e.g. `tcp`. |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.source` | dict |  |  | Source match (`address`, `port`). |
| `wan_load_balance_rules.destination` | dict |  |  | Destination match (`address`, `port`), e.g. `{port: sip}`. |
| `wan_load_balance_prune_rules` | bool |  | `true` | Delete rule settings that are not in `wan_load_balance_rules`. |
| `wan_load_balance_disable_source_nat` | bool |  | `false` | Do not SNAT outgoing traffic to the interface address. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every WAN interface is listed by `show wan-load-balance`.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wan_load_balance_interfaces` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
